The list below is generated from my curated bibliographic records. External publication profiles are also available through [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0003-1016-129X) and [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=RLWDKbMAAAAJ).

The publications are organised by **research theme** rather than chronologically. This reflects the scientific questions that connect the work across time and provides a direct bridge between the publication record and the corresponding [Research Themes](/research/index.qmd).

Within each theme, publications are ordered in reverse chronological order.
